{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "# $schema: https://json.schemastore.org/github-workflow

name: Build distributables
on:
  push:
    branches-ignore:
      - 'v*'
    paths-ignore:
      - 'docs/**'
      - '.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/**'
  pull_request:
    paths-ignore:
      - 'docs/**'
      - '.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/**'
    branches-ignore:
      - 'v*'

env:
  WEBCORD_BUILD: DEVEL

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions: {}

jobs:
  test:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        deps: ['latest', 'locked']
    name: "Test build"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 'latest'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies (NPM)
        run: npm ci

      - name: Update dependencies
        if: ${{ matrix.deps == 'latest' }}
        run: npm update --dangerously-allow-all-scripts

      - name: TSC cache
        uses: actions/cache@v6
        with:
          key: tsc-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json', 'tsconfig.json') }}
          path: |
            app
            cache/tsc.json

      - name: Run tests with ${{ matrix.deps }} dependencies
        run: npm test
  make:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        name: ['Linux', 'Windows', 'macOS']
        build: [latest, locked]
        include:
          - runner: ubuntu-latest
            name: Linux
            arch: x64,arm64
          - runner: windows-latest
            name: Windows
            arch: x64,arm64
          - runner: macos-latest
            name: macOS
            arch: x64,arm64 #,universal

    name: '${{ matrix.name }} (${{ matrix.build }})'
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    needs: ['test']
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.name == 'Windows' && '24.x' || 'latest' }}
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies (NPM)
        run: npm ci

      - name: Update dependencies
        if: ${{ matrix.build == 'latest' }}
        run: npm update

      - name: TSC cache
        uses: actions/cache@v6
        with:
          key: tsc-${{ matrix.build }}
          path: |
            app
            cache/tsc.json

      - name: Generate distributables (${{ matrix.arch }})
        uses: nick-fields/retry@v4
        with:
          retry_on: error
          max_attempts: 3
          timeout_minutes: 10
          command: npm run make -- -a ${{ matrix.arch }}

      - name: Upload distributables as artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: ${{ matrix.name }}_${{ matrix.build }}
          path: out/devel/make/*

      - name: Upload lockfile as artifact
        if: ${{ matrix.build == 'latest' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: ${{ matrix.name }}-lockfile_updated
          path: package-lock.json",
  "rationale": "The workflow is a push/pull_request build-and-test workflow, not a release or deployment, so P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE (cancel superseded runs) applies. Newer runs on the same branch or PR supersede older in-progress runs, and partitioning the concurrency group by workflow plus github.ref keeps distinct branches and PRs isolated. Adding concurrency with cancel-in-progress: true cancels redundant old runs while the latest run still executes the full test and make matrix, preserving build and test coverage. The change is minimal and top-level, weakens no permissions, and adds no secrets, privileged actions, or new network access. Preconditions are met (same workflow/branch or PR; newer revision supersedes older checks) and the listed contraindications are avoided (no deployment work; branches do not share a cancellation group because the group key includes github.ref).",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE"]
}
